mutations.label: ADR-130: a retired git event refuses unchecked work
ADR-128 T2: post-commit records no sha, so the session's own commit cannot be shown
mutations.from: if (!head.error && head.status === 0 && /^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/.test(sha)) appendEvent(owner ?? cwd, session, { event: 'commit.made', sha })
mutations.to: if (!head.error && head.status === 0 && /^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$/.test(sha)) appendEvent(owner ?? cwd, session, { event: 'commit.made' })
mutations.only: ^(?:branch\-state\ distinguishes\ session\ commits\ when\ checks\ are\ optional)$
